paragraphs: The Viano 2.0 uses the M111 — a 2.0-litre inline-four petrol engine. It was fitted from 2003 to 2014 across the W639 generation. The Viano is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every VIANO 2.0 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the VIANO 2.0 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
